headline: Indian Rupee Reverses Five-Day Rally Due to Corporate Dollar Buying
summary: The Indian rupee pulled back from seven-month highs as corporate dollar demand outweighed recent foreign portfolio capital inflows into domestic financial markets.
why: The Indian rupee's exchange rate influences import costs for crude oil and shapes foreign investor capital flow dynamics.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Heavy commercial corporate dollar purchases halted the rupee's multi-session strengthening streak.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
